A floor plan shows the door closing and footprints leaving the stand, the phone rings, and a guest with a menu waits over empty plates. The panel lights with Haniya. A top view of the table shows the scan, a guest taps chow mein and Pay becomes the paid mark. The mark crosses the room plan and the camera settles on the printer, whose lamp answers the mark. A side close shows the ticket printing. A cook's bowl pours noodles into the wok as the flame flares and the pan rocks. The owner count and bare clip are seen from above. Coins slide into the jar under a FOX 26 tag. The rule card and the blank folder box follow. A customer lowers her phone unscanned beside her quote. The film closes on the jar's two tags.
